long-1of2-answered.question: Which name should the tiny note file have?

options.label: note (Recommended)
options.detail: Use the simple base name “note” to make the file easy to recognize as a small, general-purpose note. This name leaves the subject open and works well when the file contains just a few lines of text.

options.label: quick-note
options.detail: Use the base name “quick-note” to emphasize that the file is meant for a brief thought, reminder, or observation. It gives the file a clear purpose while keeping the name short and easy to scan in a folder.

options.label: scratchpad
options.detail: Use the base name “scratchpad” to suggest a casual place for temporary thoughts, rough wording, or small reminders. This name suits a tiny note that can evolve freely without implying a polished document.
